SERVICE

Paint Protection Film (PPF)

Clear protective film designed to help protect paint from chips, scratches, and road debris.

Overview

A clear protective film solution designed to help keep your vehicle’s paint looking cleaner and protected for longer.

Paint Protection Film at HyperAuto Care provides an extra layer of protection between your vehicle’s paint and everyday road hazards.

PPF helps protect high-impact areas from stone chips, scratches, and other damage caused by daily driving.

Our team carefully prepares and installs the film to create a clean finish while maintaining the original appearance of your vehicle.




Ideal for drivers who want to protect their vehicle’s paint from daily road conditions.

Protect your vehicle’s original paint from the beginning.

Reduce the risk of damage caused by road debris and long-distance driving.

Help maintain the appearance of vehicles where paint condition is especially important.

A smart choice for owners planning to keep their vehicle for many years.

Service Process

Our PPF Installation Process At HyperAuto Care

Step 01
Vehicle Inspection

We check the vehicle condition and discuss the recommended protection areas.

Step 02
Surface Preparation

The paint is cleaned and prepared before applying the protective film.

Step 03
Film Installation

The PPF is carefully installed on selected areas of the vehicle.

Step 04
Final Inspection

We review the installation and make sure the film meets our quality standards.

Why Choose HyperAuto Care For Paint Protection Film

PPF helps protect your vehicle’s paint while keeping its original appearance.

Protect Against Road Damage

Help reduce damage from rocks, road debris, and everyday driving conditions.

Keep Your Original Paint

Maintain the factory paint condition and help preserve your vehicle’s appearance.

Reduce Paint Maintenance

Protect high-impact areas that are more likely to receive scratches and chips.

Add Long-Term Protection

A practical solution for owners who want extra protection beyond regular washing and waxing.
